remarks:
This well-maintained country home sits on 1.67 acres located in Belmont NY, Allegany County.

Perched on a gentle rise overlooking its spacious yard, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath manufactured home offers the peaceful country setting and functional floor plan today's buyers are looking for.

With 1,512 square feet of main-level living plus a full basement with exterior walk-up access, you'll have valuable storage space today and extra flexibility for future needs. The open floor plan creates a natural flow between the spacious living room, dining area, and kitchen making it easy to stay connected whether you're preparing dinner, helping with homework, or gathering with family and friends. The kitchen features a pantry, newer stainless steel appliances, and generous cabinet space overlooking the dining area.

A separate den offers the flexibility to use as a home office, playroom, hobby room, or second living area. Down the hallway you'll find two comfortable bedrooms, a full guest bath, and a conveniently located laundry room. The private primary suite is thoughtfully situated on the opposite end of the home and includes a spacious full bath with a double vanity and a whirlpool tub.

Outside, you'll appreciate the expansive yard with room for gardening, outdoor recreation, pets, and family gatherings. Mature trees provide a beautiful backdrop to the property, while the detached storage shed offers convenient storage for lawn equipment, tools, and seasonal items. The deck is an inviting place to relax and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

Recent improvements include a new water well, pump, and pressure tank installed in April 2026, along with a hot water tank that is less than five years old. The home also offers central air for added comfort throughout the warmer months.

Located just 10 minutes from both Belmont and Wellsville, you'll enjoy the quiet of country living while remaining close to schools, shopping, restaurants, and everyday conveniences.

If you've been searching for a property that offers space to enjoy today with room to make it your own for years to come, this is one you'll want to see.
